**local-business-live-skills v0.1.2 Changelog**

- Major expansion of the codebase: added 83 new files, including external strategy guides, internal documentation, and HTML tools.
- Introduced remote HTML diagnosis tool (diagnosis-tool.html) for merchant self-diagnosis—no installation required.
- Added comprehensive skill documentation, playbooks, and workflow instructions for self-service store diagnosis, video scripting, livestream prep, and data review.
- Expanded reference library with role-specific guides covering copywriting, video editing, Douyin operations, strategy, and compliance (external/).
- Provided real merchant case studies, action checklists, and a structured diagnostic questionnaire.
- Removed outdated skill-card.md; updated and unified SKILL.md for consistency and full feature documentation.

**local-business-live-skills v0.1.1 Changelog**

- Added new reference and template files: expanded resources with diagnosis question lists and a diagnosis report HTML template.
- Introduced three new sub-skills for China ecommerce, growth marketing, and sales/lead generation strategy.
- Updated main documentation (SKILL.md) to reflect new supported modes and skill composition.
- Removed old skill-card.md—transitioned to new structure and reference system.

Initial release with comprehensive local business live coaching tools.

- Enables local business owners to self-diagnose store operations by answering 20 guided questions.
- Automatically generates a diagnostic report, provides live pitch video scripts, and actionable follow-up plans.
- Offers tools for diagnosis, scriptwriting, live acquisition, data review, and iterative improvement.
- Suitable for various sectors: dining, beauty, hospitality, parent-child, and retail.
- Includes both hands-on self-service mode and detailed methodology for advanced users.
- Supports feedback and continuous optimization through real business case studies and frameworks.
